name: Princes of Qing
storyline: In a tense peace maintained by the Great Marriage Alliance between rival empires Zhou and Qing, a young commoner infiltrates the palace in a bid to rise to the highest rung of society.
summary:
Can you survive the imperial palace without being exposed?
Princes of Qing is a palace intrigue roleplaying game where two street thieves infiltrate an imperial marriage selection.
You play as one of them.
If your lie is exposed, you die.
Rise from nobody to palace power through deception.
Every choice reshapes your fate.
